gaps: This is the weakest-sourced crop in the whole task. No dedicated, openable product page for any named chilli cultivar was found: guessed Starke Ayres URLs for Cayenne / Hot Chilli Mix returned HTTP 500, and guessed Sakata URLs for Malagueta and Habanero Red returned HTTP 404. Sakata's chilli category listing page also returned 404.

Both entries above are included only because their names appear verbatim in a real, directly-fetched page's site-navigation menu (a Starke Ayres product page fetched for the peppers crop) — this is NOT a product description or agronomic claim, only proof the name is sold. Per the brief's honesty rule, no maturity, season, traits, type or zone claim has been attached to either.

Starke Ayres' own 'Sweet & Hot Peppers Production Guideline' (fetched and read in full for the peppers.json file) covers chilli agronomically alongside sweet pepper but names no specific chilli cultivars.

No ARC, DAFF/DALRRD, or KZN DARD source naming specific chilli cultivars was found or opened in this pass — crop-catalog.ts's own chilli entry already notes it shares KZN DARD's generic 'Capsicum' sow-window/spacing/yield row with peppers, which was not re-verified here.
Given the weakness of what was found, no honest zone-level recommendation could be written; zoneAdvice is empty rather than guessed.
